Claim 13 (Currently amended): A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, and wherein the flexible tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body that is removably attachable to the flexible tube.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube and includes a multi-layered design.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the insulating sheathing body.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design that enhances thermal insulation.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube made from a spirally reinforced plastic material.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the flexible tube.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes a pressure measuring tube connection that is integrated into the second portion.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising a respiratory gas humidifier that is adapted to be connected to a water source via a humidification line.

Claim 22 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via a humidification line that is integrated into the flexible tube.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a flexible tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material that provides enhanced flexibility.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater that is integrated into the flexible tube.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact surface is provided within the second portion and has a defined shape for improved electrical contact.

Claim 28 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion to facilitate connection with the CPAP device.

Claim 29 (Currently amended): A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein each contact surface is provided within the second portion and has a defined shape for improved electrical contact.

Claim 31 (Currently amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion to facilitate connection with the CPAP device.
